data.name: +1 Glow Up Evolution
data.description:
✨ Welcome to Glow Up Evolution! ✨
Start sleepy, become a superstar, and unlock boys as you glow up!

💖 HOW TO PLAY
🧴 Tap to spray perfume and earn Beauty!
🛍️ Upgrade your perfumes for bigger boosts!
💅 Train at the Spa and Photo Studio!
🏆 Beat rival girls in Beauty Duels to unlock your next look!
🌟 Collect boys who get taller, more stylish, and earn Wins for you!
🔄 Rebirth to start again stronger!

Discover 11 girl looks and unlock 20 boys on your journey through Glow Up City!

✨ Can you reach Superstar? ✨

data.name: [🍀] Towers of Fortune
data.description:
Everyone spawns on their own pillar. Every few seconds you get a RANDOM item... build, bridge, fight, and be the LAST ONE STANDING! 🏆

⚔️ HOW TO PLAY
🧱 Get random items and blocks every few seconds
🌉 Bridge to other pillars and knock players into the void
💀 Get kills for bonus blocks and coins
👑 Last one alive wins!

👥 Join the group for FREE daily rewards!
👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for updates!

data.name: Dig & Collect
data.description:
Dig through the sand, create paths, and collect as many balls as possible! Can you guide them all to the finish? 🏆

⛏️ Dig your way through the sand!
🟠 Collect hundreds of colorful balls!
🧠 Create the perfect path to save every ball!
🚧 Avoid obstacles and tricky traps!
🌈 Complete satisfying and challenging levels!
🏆 Become the best ball collector!

💡 The more balls you collect, the better!

👍 Like the game for more updates!

data.name: Clean The Bugs 🐜
data.description:
👍2,000 LIKES = NEW MAP 👍

🐛 Bugs have taken over! Gear up as an exterminator and clean up the infestation by squishing thousands of bugs!

👥 Clean up alone or with friends!
🏁 Race for the fastest times on the leaderboard!
🔓 Unlock powerful tools and upgrades to make the job easier!
🔍 Discover the secrets behind the infestation!

data.name: [⚔️W2] +1 Sukuna Evolution
data.description:
👹 Eat Sukuna's cursed fingers and become the King of Curses! Every finger turns your avatar one step more into Sukuna: his marks, four eyes, tattoos, pink hair, and finally four arms!

🎁 CODES: SUKUNA, KINGOFCURSES

🖱️ Click to gain +1 Cursed Energy!
☝️ Eat 13 cursed fingers, each stage stronger than the last!
⚔️ Unlock Sukuna's moves: Dismantle, Cleave, Spiderweb, Fuga and more!
⛩️ Open Malevolent Shrine!
🔥 Fight through 15 stages of curses and bosses!
👑 Can you beat Gojo, the strongest?
🏆 Earn Wins and climb the leaderboards!
🐺 Hatch shikigami pets for big boosts!
🔥 Equip cursed flames to multiply your power!
🔄 Rebirth to become even stronger!
💤 Keep gaining Cursed Energy while offline!
👥 Join the group for +10% Cursed Energy!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to support updates!

data.name: 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA]
data.description:
Welcome to Cell 13. Your release date? Never.

Something strange happens after lights out. Prisoners are taken behind the STAFF ONLY door... and they don't come back the same. Escape before it's your turn.

🔒 Play solo or team up with up to 3 friends.
🥔 Work prison jobs, earn cash, and buy tools from OJ's Deals.
🥄 Hide your tools, move the toilet, and dig your way out.
🔦 Explore dark tunnels and uncover the prison's secrets.
👮 Stay ready for roll call, avoid guards and CCTV, and keep your suspicion low.

Act normal by day. Plan your escape by night.
